decisions.mark: distinguishes the two ways to substitute an allocator — a COMPILE-time pair of macros versus a RUNTIME pair of function pointers — and states that they are mutually exclusive
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "**Compile-time.** Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` ... **Run-time.** Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, then call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`" | WHY: The answer names both the compile-time macro pair and the run-time function-pointer pair, but never says they are mutually exclusive. It also describes the runtime pointers as the default target of the macro path, which implies they work together. || QUOTE: "Compile-time.
